source.text: Τούτου χάριν ἐγὼ Παῦλος ὁ δέσμιος τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν εἴ γε ἠκούσατε τὴν οἰκονομίαν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς·

records.literal_gloss: For this reason I Paul, the prisoner of the Christ Jesus on behalf of you the Gentiles— \v 2 if indeed you heard [of] the stewardship of the grace of the God, the [one] having been given to me for you;

en.L: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles— \v 2 if indeed you have heard of the stewardship of the grace of God that was given to me for you.
en.B: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles— \v 2 surely you have heard how God entrusted me with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, to manage it for your good.
en.R: This is why I, Paul, a prisoner because I serve {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles, who are not Jews—but before I go on, let me explain. \v 2 You have surely heard that God trusted me with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, so that I would bring it to you.

es.L: Por esta razón yo, Pablo, el prisionero {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús a favor de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} los gentiles— \v 2 si es que {{plural_you:han oído|habéis oído}} de la mayordomía de la gracia de Dios que me fue dada para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Por esta razón yo, Pablo, prisionero {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús por causa de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los gentiles— \v 2 sin duda {{plural_you:han oído|habéis oído}} que Dios me confió {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia para que yo la administrara en bien {{plural_you:de ustedes|vuestro}}.
es.R: Por eso yo, Pablo, que estoy preso por servir a {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús, lo estoy por el bien de {{plural_you:ustedes, los que no son judíos|vosotros, los que no sois judíos}}. Pero antes de seguir, {{plural_you:permítanme explicarles|permitidme explicaros}} algo. \v 2 Sin duda {{plural_you:han oído|habéis oído}} que Dios me confió {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia para que yo {{plural_you:se la llevara a ustedes|os la llevara a vosotros}}.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hii mimi, Paulo, mfungwa wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kwa ajili yenu, ninyi watu wa mataifa— \v 2 ikiwa kweli mmesikia habari ya uwakili wa neema ya Mungu ambayo nilipewa kwa ajili yenu.
sw.B: Kwa sababu hii mimi, Paulo, niliye mfungwa wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kwa ajili yenu, ninyi watu wa mataifa— \v 2 hakika mmesikia jinsi Mungu alivyonikabidhi neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ili niisimamie kwa faida yenu.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu mimi, Paulo, niko kifungoni kwa kuwa ninamtumikia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kwa ajili yenu ninyi watu wasio Wayahudi. Lakini kabla sijaendelea, acheni niwaeleze jambo moja. \v 2 Bila shaka mmesikia kwamba Mungu alinikabidhi neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ili niwaletee ninyi.

decisions.choice: the sentence breaks off: Paul begins to say what he does "for this reason", turns aside in verses 2-13 to explain the task God gave him, and takes up the thread again in verse 14 with the same words
alternatives: supply "am": "I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus"
the main verb is the "I urge you" of 4:1
decisions.reason: Τούτου χάριν ("for this reason") opens verse 1 and again verse 14, where the main verb finally comes: "I bow my knees". Between them, verse 2 starts a side thought, and verses 3-13 explain the mystery Paul was given to proclaim. A sentence that breaks off and is resumed later (an anacoluthon) is natural in a letter that was dictated (compare Romans 16:22). Supplying "am" gives a complete sentence, but leaves "for this reason" with nothing to introduce. "For this reason" looks back to 2:11-22: Gentiles now belong with Israel in God's one household.

decisions.choice: the prisoner of Christ Jesus: in prison because of Christ, and as one who belongs to him
alternatives: simply a prisoner held by Rome
decisions.reason: Paul writes from prison (4:1; 6:20). The genitive τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ says whose prisoner he is: in the end not Rome's but Christ's, since it is Christ's cause that put him in chains (Philemon 1, 9). "For the sake of you Gentiles" ties his chains to his mission to the Gentiles; his arrest in Jerusalem began with the charge that he had brought Gentiles into the temple (Acts 21:28-29).

decisions.choice: the Gentiles: the peoples other than Israel, as most of the readers were
decisions.reason: ἐθνῶν means "the nations", and in Jewish use the peoples other than Israel. Chapter 2 has just said that Gentiles who were once far off have been brought near (2:11-13).

decisions.choice: if indeed you have heard: an "if" that takes the answer to be yes
alternatives: a real doubt: "if you have heard at all"
decisions.reason: εἴ γε introduces a condition the writer assumes is true, as in 4:21 and Colossians 1:23. The wording suits readers who had heard of Paul's commission rather than seen it at first hand. Paul worked in Ephesus for more than two years (Acts 19:10; 20:31), so it may point to believers who came to faith after he left, or to churches beyond Ephesus.

decisions.choice: stewardship: the trust given to Paul to manage God's grace for others, like a steward who manages a household for its master
alternatives: God's plan or administration of grace, as in verse 9 and 1:10
decisions.reason: οἰκονομίαν is the work of a household manager (Luke 16:2-4). Paul uses the word of his own commission in Colossians 1:25 and 1 Corinthians 9:17. The grace God gave Paul was given "for you": not for himself alone, but to be passed on to the Gentiles. In verse 9 the same word is used of God's own ordering of his plan.

decisions.choice: grace: God's free kindness, here given to Paul as his calling to the Gentiles
decisions.reason: Verses 7-8 say what this grace is: the gift that made Paul a servant of the gospel and sent him to the Gentiles (compare Romans 1:5; 15:15-16).

decisions.choice: a dash after "Gentiles"
decisions.reason: The English shows the break where the Greek sentence breaks off (m1). The thought is resumed in verse 14.

decisions.choice: This is why I, Paul ... —but before I go on, let me explain.
alternatives: leave the sentence unfinished with a dash
decisions.reason: Readable tells the reader plainly that Paul breaks off and will come back to his point (m1).

decisions.choice: God entrusted me with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, to manage it for your good (B); God trusted me with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, so that I would bring it to you (R)
alternatives: the stewardship of God's grace given to me for you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the household word means here (m5) rather than keep "stewardship", which few readers use. Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: you Gentiles, who are not Jews
decisions.reason: Readable explains "Gentiles" the first time it comes in the chapter (m3).

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the readers in the plural throughout the letter. Each plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain), as in Philippians 4.

decisions.choice: mayordomía
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the household picture of a steward entrusted with his master's goods (m5) with "mayordomía". "Administración" sounds like an office or a government, and "dispensación" is an older word few readers now understand. Balanced and Readable explain the word, as the English does.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on free pronouns and possessives
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb ("alinikabidhi"), and a prefix cannot take a capital. So the setting applies only to free pronouns and possessives such as "neema yake", and the Swahili text has fewer spans than the English throughout this chapter.

decisions.choice: uwakili (L); alivyonikabidhi ... ili niisimamie (B)
decisions.reason: "Uwakili" is the work of a "wakili", the steward who manages a household for its owner, which is the picture of m5. "Madaraka" (authority, office) loses the household and "huduma" (service) loses the trust. Balanced says it as a verb, God entrusted ("kukabidhi") his grace to Paul to manage ("kusimamia").

source.text: κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν ἐγνωρίσθη μοι τὸ μυστήριον, καθὼς προέγραψα ἐν ὀλίγῳ, πρὸς ὃ δύνασθε ἀναγινώσκοντες νοῆσαι τὴν σύνεσίν μου ἐν τῷ μυστηρίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὃ ἑτέραις γενεαῖς οὐκ ἐγνωρίσθη τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὡς νῦν ἀπεκαλύφθη τοῖς ἁγίοις ἀποστόλοις αὐτοῦ καὶ προφήταις ἐν πνεύματι, εἶναι τὰ ἔθνη συγκληρονόμα καὶ σύσσωμα καὶ συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου, οὗ ἐγενήθην διάκονος κατὰ τὴν δωρεὰν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ ἐμοὶ τῷ ἐλαχιστοτέρῳ πάντων ἁγίων ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις αὕτη τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαι τὸ ἀνεξιχνίαστον πλοῦτος τοῦ Χριστοῦ, καὶ φωτίσαι πάντας τίς ἡ οἰκονομία τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ ἀποκεκρυμμένου ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων ἐν τῷ θεῷ τῷ τὰ πάντα κτίσαντι, ἵνα γνωρισθῇ νῦν ταῖς ἀρχαῖς καὶ ταῖς ἐξουσίαις ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις διὰ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἡ πολυποίκιλος σοφία τοῦ θεοῦ, κατὰ πρόθεσιν τῶν αἰώνων ἣν ἐποίησεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν, ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ προσαγωγὴν ἐν πεποιθήσει διὰ τῆς πίστεως αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: By revelation was made known to me the mystery, just as I wrote before in brief, \v 4 toward which you are able, reading, to understand the insight of me in the mystery of the Christ, \v 5 which in other generations was not made known to the sons of the men as now it was revealed to the holy apostles of him and prophets in [the] Spirit, \v 6 [that] the Gentiles to be fellow heirs and fellow body and fellow sharers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel, \v 7 of which I became servant according to the gift of the grace of the God, the [one] having been given to me according to the working of the power of him. \v 8 To me, the less-than-least of all holy [ones], was given the grace this: to the Gentiles to proclaim as good news the untraceable riches of the Christ, \v 9 and to bring to light all [people] what [is] the plan of the mystery, the [one] having been hidden from the ages in the God, the [one] the all things having created, \v 10 so that may be made known now to the rulers and to the authorities in the heavenly [places] through the church the many-sided wisdom of the God, \v 11 according to purpose of the ages which he made in the Christ Jesus the Lord of us, \v 12 in whom we have the boldness and access in confidence through the faith of him.

en.L: By revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in brief. \v 4 By this, as you read, you are able to understand my insight into the mystery of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 5 which in other generations was not made known to the {{gender:children of humankind|sons of men}} as it has now been revealed to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy apostles and prophets by [the] Spirit: \v 6 [that] the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body and fellow sharers of the promise in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus through the gospel, \v 7 of which I became a servant according to the gift of the grace of God that was given to me according to the working of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power. \v 8 To me, the less than least of all [the] holy ones, this grace was given: to announce to the Gentiles the good news of the untraceable riches of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 9 and to bring to light for all what [is] the plan of the mystery that has been hidden from the ages in God, who created all things, \v 10 so that now the many-sided wisdom of God might be made known to the rulers and the authorities in the heavenly [places] through the church, \v 11 according to the purpose of the ages which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus our Lord, \v 12 in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through faith in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: God made the mystery known to me by revelation, as I have briefly written already. \v 4 When you read this, you will be able to see my understanding of the mystery of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 5 In other generations it was not made known to {{gender:humankind|the sons of men}} as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy apostles and prophets. \v 6 This is the mystery: through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, members of the same body, and sharers together in the promise in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. \v 7 I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God's grace, which was given to me through the working of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power. \v 8 Though I am less than the least of all God's holy people, this grace was given to me: to bring the Gentiles the good news of the riches of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, riches no one can ever fully trace, \v 9 and to make plain to everyone how the mystery is being carried out, the mystery that for ages past was hidden in God, who created all things. \v 10 God's aim was that now, through the church, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom in all its rich variety would be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly places. \v 11 This was in keeping with the purpose {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has had through all the ages, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} carried out in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus our Lord. \v 12 In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, through faith in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, we can come to God boldly and with confidence.
en.R: God showed me {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mystery, the plan {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had kept hidden. I have already written a little about it. \v 4 When you read what I wrote, you will see that I understand this mystery about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 5 People who lived in earlier times were not told it in the way it has now been shown, by the Spirit, to God's holy apostles and prophets. \v 6 Here is the mystery: through the good news, people who are not Jews are heirs together with the Jewish people, and will receive what God has promised to give. They are members of one body with them, and they share with them in God's promise, because they are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. \v 7 God made me a servant of this good news. It was a gift of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, given to me by the working of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power. \v 8 I am less important than the least of all God's people. Yet God gave me this grace: to tell the Gentiles the good news about the riches of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, riches too great for anyone to measure. \v 9 He also gave me the work of helping everyone see how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is carrying out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mystery. For long ages God, who created everything, kept this plan hidden. \v 10 But now {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants to use the church to show the rulers and authorities in the heavenly world, the unseen powers, how wise {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is, and how many sides {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wisdom has. \v 11 This was God's purpose through all the ages, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has carried it out in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus our Lord. \v 12 Because we are joined to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and have faith in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, we can come near to God boldly and without fear.

es.L: Por revelación me fue dado a conocer el misterio, como antes escribí en breve. \v 4 Por esto, al leer, {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} entender mi comprensión del misterio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, \v 5 que en otras generaciones no fue dado a conocer a {{gender:los hijos de la humanidad|los hijos de los hombres}} como ahora ha sido revelado a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos apóstoles y profetas por [el] Espíritu: \v 6 [que] los gentiles son coherederos y miembros del mismo cuerpo y copartícipes de la promesa en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús por medio del evangelio, \v 7 del cual llegué a ser servidor según el don de la gracia de Dios que me fue dada según la acción de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder. \v 8 A mí, inferior al más pequeño de todos [los] santos, me fue dada esta gracia: anunciar a los gentiles la buena noticia de las riquezas imposibles de rastrear {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, \v 9 y sacar a la luz para todos cuál [es] el plan del misterio escondido desde los siglos en Dios, que creó todas las cosas, \v 10 para que ahora la multiforme sabiduría de Dios sea dada a conocer a los gobernantes y a las autoridades en los [lugares] celestiales por medio de la iglesia, \v 11 conforme al propósito de los siglos que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} realizó en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús nuestro Señor, \v 12 en quien tenemos la franqueza y el acceso, con confianza, por la fe en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Dios me dio a conocer el misterio por revelación, como ya he escrito brevemente. \v 4 Cuando {{plural_you:lean|leáis}} esto, {{plural_you:podrán|podréis}} ver cómo entiendo yo el misterio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. \v 5 En otras generaciones no se dio a conocer a {{gender:la humanidad|los hijos de los hombres}} como ahora el Espíritu lo ha revelado a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} santos apóstoles y profetas. \v 6 Este es el misterio: por medio del evangelio, los gentiles son coherederos, forman parte del mismo cuerpo y comparten la promesa en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús. \v 7 Llegué a ser servidor de este evangelio por el don de la gracia de Dios, que se me concedió por la acción de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder. \v 8 Aunque soy menos que el más pequeño de todo el pueblo santo de Dios, se me concedió esta gracia: llevar a los gentiles la buena noticia de las riquezas {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, riquezas que nadie podrá jamás rastrear del todo, \v 9 y mostrar con claridad a todos cómo se está llevando a cabo el misterio que durante siglos estuvo escondido en Dios, que creó todas las cosas. \v 10 El propósito de Dios era que ahora, por medio de la iglesia, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría, rica en matices, se diera a conocer a los gobernantes y autoridades en los lugares celestiales. \v 11 Esto concuerda con el propósito que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha tenido a lo largo de todos los siglos, y que llevó a cabo en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús nuestro Señor. \v 12 En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, por la fe en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, podemos acercarnos a Dios con libertad y confianza.
es.R: Dios me mostró {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} misterio, el plan que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había mantenido escondido. Ya he escrito un poco sobre esto. \v 4 Cuando {{plural_you:lean|leáis}} lo que escribí, {{plural_you:verán|veréis}} que entiendo este misterio acerca {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. \v 5 A la gente que vivió en tiempos pasados no se le dio a conocer como ahora el Espíritu lo ha mostrado a los santos apóstoles y profetas de Dios. \v 6 Este es el misterio: por medio de la buena noticia, los que no son judíos son herederos junto con el pueblo judío, y recibirán lo que Dios ha prometido dar. Son miembros de un solo cuerpo con los judíos y comparten con ellos la promesa de Dios, porque están unidos a {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús. \v 7 Dios me hizo servidor de esta buena noticia. Fue un regalo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, que me dio por la acción de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder. \v 8 Soy menos importante que el más pequeño de todo el pueblo de Dios. Sin embargo, Dios me dio esta gracia: anunciar a los que no son judíos la buena noticia de las riquezas {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, riquezas tan grandes que nadie las puede medir. \v 9 También me dio la tarea de ayudar a todos a ver cómo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está llevando a cabo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} misterio. Durante largos siglos Dios, que creó todo, mantuvo escondido este plan. \v 10 Pero ahora quiere usar a la iglesia para mostrar a los gobernantes y autoridades del mundo celestial, los poderes invisibles, lo sabio que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es y cuántas caras tiene {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sabiduría. \v 11 Este fue el propósito de Dios a lo largo de todos los siglos, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo ha cumplido en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús nuestro Señor. \v 12 Como estamos unidos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y tenemos fe en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, podemos acercarnos a Dios con libertad y sin miedo.

sw.L: Kwa ufunuo nilijulishwa siri, kama nilivyoandika kabla kwa ufupi. \v 4 Kwa hilo, mnaposoma, mnaweza kutambua uelewa wangu wa siri ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 5 ambayo katika vizazi vingine haikujulishwa kwa wanadamu kama ilivyofunuliwa sasa kwa Roho kwa mitume {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakatifu na kwa manabii: \v 6 [kwamba] watu wa mataifa ni warithi wenza, na wa mwili uleule, na washiriki wenza wa ahadi katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kupitia Injili, \v 7 ambayo nilifanyika mtumishi wake kulingana na zawadi ya neema ya Mungu iliyotolewa kwangu kulingana na kazi ya nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \v 8 Kwangu mimi, niliye duni kuliko aliye duni kabisa wa watakatifu wote, ilitolewa neema hii: kuwatangazia watu wa mataifa Injili ya utajiri wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} usioweza kufuatiliwa nyayo zake, \v 9 na kuwaangazia wote mpango wa siri ni nini, ile iliyofichwa tangu enzi ndani ya Mungu aliyeumba vitu vyote, \v 10 ili sasa hekima ya Mungu yenye sura nyingi ijulishwe kwa watawala na kwa wenye mamlaka katika [mahali] pa mbinguni kupitia kanisa, \v 11 kulingana na kusudi la enzi ambalo alilitimiza katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wetu, \v 12 ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} tuna uhuru wa kusema na haki ya kukaribia, kwa uhakika, kupitia imani {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.B: Mungu alinijulisha siri hiyo kwa ufunuo, kama nilivyokwisha kuandika kwa ufupi. \v 4 Mtakaposoma haya, mtaweza kuona jinsi ninavyoielewa siri ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 5 Katika vizazi vingine wanadamu hawakujulishwa siri hiyo kama ambavyo sasa Roho ameifunua kwa mitume {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakatifu na kwa manabii. \v 6 Siri yenyewe ni hii: kupitia Injili, watu wa mataifa ni warithi wenza, ni viungo vya mwili uleule, na wanashiriki pamoja ahadi iliyo katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. \v 7 Nilifanyika mtumishi wa Injili hii kwa zawadi ya neema ya Mungu, niliyopewa kwa kazi ya nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \v 8 Ingawa mimi ni mdogo kuliko aliye mdogo kabisa wa watakatifu wote, nilipewa neema hii: kuwapelekea watu wa mataifa Injili ya utajiri wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, utajiri ambao hakuna mtu atakayeweza kuufuatilia hadi mwisho wake, \v 9 na kuwaonyesha watu wote waziwazi jinsi siri hiyo inavyotekelezwa, siri ambayo kwa enzi zote zilizopita ilifichwa ndani ya Mungu, aliyeumba vitu vyote. \v 10 Lengo la Mungu lilikuwa kwamba sasa, kupitia kanisa, hekima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yenye sura nyingi ijulikane kwa watawala na wenye mamlaka katika ulimwengu wa mbinguni. \v 11 Hili lilikuwa kulingana na kusudi ambalo amekuwa nalo tangu enzi zote, ambalo alilitimiza katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu Bwana wetu. \v 12 Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kwa imani {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, tunaweza kumkaribia Mungu kwa ujasiri na kwa uhakika.
sw.R: Mungu alinionyesha siri {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, yaani mpango aliokuwa ameuficha. decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: verse 3 begins without ὅτι ("that")
alternatives: "that by revelation the mystery was made known to me", continuing verse 2
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts begin verse 3 with ὅτι, so that it says what the readers have heard: "that by revelation the mystery was made known to me". Others, including some early ones, lack the word, and the SBLGNT does not print it. The sense hardly changes: verse 3 still explains the stewardship of verse 2.

decisions.choice: mystery: a secret of God's purpose, hidden until he revealed it; here, that Gentiles share fully with Israel in Christ (verse 6)
decisions.reason: In the Bible, μυστήριον is a secret that only God can disclose (Daniel 2:28), and Paul uses it for God's plan now made known in Christ (Romans 16:25-26; Colossians 1:26-27). It is not a puzzle, and it is not kept for a few: verse 9 says it is to be made plain to everyone. Paul received it "by revelation", not from human teachers (Galatians 1:12).

decisions.choice: as I wrote before in brief: earlier in this letter
decisions.reason: προέγραψα ("I wrote before") most naturally points back to what Paul has just written in 1:9-10 and 2:11-22, which verse 4 invites the readers to read again.

decisions.choice: as you read: as the letter is read, usually aloud to the gathered church
decisions.reason: ἀναγινώσκοντες ("reading"): letters were read aloud to the assembled believers (Colossians 4:16; 1 Thessalonians 5:27), so most of the readers were hearers. What they hear will let them judge Paul's grasp of the mystery for themselves.

decisions.choice: not made known as it now has been: the full mystery was not known before, though the Scriptures had promised blessing to the nations
alternatives: not made known at all before
decisions.reason: ὡς νῦν ("as now") compares then and now. The Old Testament spoke of the nations being blessed through Abraham (Genesis 12:3) and turning to Israel's God (Isaiah 49:6), and Paul quotes such promises (Romans 15:9-12). What had not been made known was the way it would happen: Gentiles made members, on equal terms, of one body with Israel. Colossians 1:26 says the mystery was hidden for ages; the two statements fit together.

decisions.choice: the sons of men: human beings
decisions.reason: τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων is a Hebrew way of saying "human beings", as in Mark 3:28. It includes men and women.

decisions.choice: holy apostles and prophets: the apostles and the prophets of the church
decisions.reason: The mystery was not made known in earlier generations, so the prophets who have received it "now" are prophets of the church, as in 2:20 and 4:11, where they are named with the apostles. "Holy" marks them as set apart by God for this task, not as holier than other believers: verse 8 calls all believers holy.

decisions.choice: by the Spirit: the Spirit is the one through whom God revealed it
decisions.reason: ἐν πνεύματι goes with "was revealed". The Spirit makes known what God has prepared (1 Corinthians 2:10), and Paul has prayed for the Spirit of wisdom and revelation for his readers too (1:17).

decisions.choice: fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, fellow sharers: the Gentiles stand alongside Jewish believers in the inheritance, in the one body, and in the promise
decisions.reason: The infinitive εἶναι spells out what the mystery is. Each of the three words begins with the prefix σύν, "together with": συγκληρονόμα, heirs together of what God promised Abraham's children (Galatians 3:29); σύσσωμα, "of the same body", a word not known in Greek writing before this letter (compare 2:16; 4:4); and συμμέτοχα, sharing together in the promise, though they were once "strangers to the covenants of promise" (2:12). The partner in each is Israel: the Gentiles stand beside Jewish believers, not below them (2:19).

decisions.choice: in Christ Jesus, through the gospel: the Gentiles share these things by being joined to Christ, and they come to it through the gospel preached and believed
decisions.reason: "In Christ Jesus" names where the promise is fulfilled (1:3; 2:13); "through the gospel" names the means by which the Gentiles enter it, which leads into Paul's own part in verse 7.

decisions.choice: servant: one who serves the gospel
decisions.reason: διάκονος here is not the church office of deacon (Philippians 1:1) but a servant of the gospel, as in Colossians 1:23. Paul became one by God's gift and power, not by his own choice or worth.

decisions.choice: less than the least: a comparative built on a superlative
decisions.reason: ἐλαχιστοτέρῳ takes the word for "least" and adds the ending for "lesser": lower than the lowest. Paul speaks this way because he once persecuted the church (1 Corinthians 15:9; 1 Timothy 1:13-15). His sense of being unworthy makes the grace given to him stand out.

decisions.choice: untraceable: too great to be searched out to the end
decisions.reason: ἀνεξιχνίαστον describes a trail whose tracks cannot be followed to its end. Romans 11:33 uses it of God's ways. The riches of Christ are not hidden; they are too great ever to be fully explored.

decisions.choice: the plan of the mystery: the way God orders and carries out the purpose he once kept hidden
alternatives: Paul's stewardship of the mystery, as in verse 2
decisions.reason: In verse 2 οἰκονομίαν is Paul's commission. Here Paul is to make plain to everyone what the οἰκονομία of the mystery is: how God has arranged and is carrying out his hidden purpose, as in 1:10. The two senses belong together: God runs his household by a plan, and Paul is a steward within it.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "plan"
alternatives: κοινωνία: "what is the fellowship of the mystery"
decisions.reason: Late manuscripts read κοινωνία ("fellowship") here, the reading behind "the fellowship of the mystery" in the King James Version. The early manuscripts read οἰκονομία.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "to bring to light for all"
alternatives: "to bring to light what the plan of the mystery is", without "all"
decisions.reason: A few important early manuscripts lack πάντας ("all"). With the word, Paul enlightens all people; without it, he brings the plan itself to light. Either way, what was hidden is now made public.

decisions.choice: hidden from the ages in God: hidden through all past ages, kept in God's own purpose
alternatives: hidden from the ages as from personal powers
decisions.reason: ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων is a phrase of time, as in Colossians 1:26. "In God" says where the secret was kept: in God's own purpose, not written where anyone could find it. Naming God as the one "who created all things" ties the plan of renewal to the Creator himself.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "who created all things"
alternatives: "who created all things through Jesus Christ"
decisions.reason: Later manuscripts add "through Jesus Christ", the reading of the King James Version. The early manuscripts do not have it.

decisions.choice: the rulers and authorities in the heavenly places: spiritual powers in the unseen world
decisions.reason: Paul uses ἀρχαῖς and ἐξουσίαις for unseen powers (1:21; 6:12; Colossians 1:16; 2:15). ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις is the unseen realm where Christ now reigns over every power (1:20-21) and where hostile powers still fight (6:12). The text does not say whether good powers, evil powers or both are meant here.

decisions.choice: through the church: the church itself, Jews and Gentiles made one, shows God's wisdom to the powers
decisions.reason: The church does not preach to the powers; its existence displays God's wisdom to them. A people made one out of groups that were once enemies (2:14-16) shows what God's wisdom can do. πολυποίκιλος means "richly varied", literally "many-colored", which suits a wisdom that brings many peoples into one body.

decisions.choice: the purpose of the ages, which he carried out in Christ Jesus
alternatives: which he formed in Christ Jesus
decisions.reason: "Of the ages" means the purpose God has held through all ages, his eternal purpose (1:4, 1:11). ἐποίησεν ("he made") can mean that God formed this purpose or that he carried it out. The past tense and "in Christ Jesus our Lord" point to its being carried out in Christ's coming, death and resurrection; the purpose itself was formed before the world began (1:4).

decisions.choice: boldness and access: freedom to speak openly, and the right to approach God
decisions.reason: παρρησίαν is freedom to speak openly, without fear. προσαγωγὴν is the right to come near; 2:18 uses it for access to the Father through Christ. "In confidence" adds that believers come trusting they will be welcomed (Hebrews 4:16).

decisions.choice: through faith in him
decisions.reason: πίστεως αὐτοῦ can mean faith that rests on Christ or Christ's own faithfulness. In this letter faith is the believers' trust in Christ (1:15; 3:17), so "faith in him" fits best here.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mystery, the plan {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had kept hidden
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "mystery" and says at once what it means here (m2), since in everyday English a mystery is a puzzle or a detective story.

decisions.choice: {{gender:children of humankind|sons of men}} (L); {{gender:humankind|the sons of men}} (B)
decisions.reason: The phrase means human beings (m6), so the default is inclusive; the traditional wording is the alternative. Readable says "people".

decisions.choice: fellow heirs, members of the same body, sharers together (B); heirs together with the Jewish people ... members of one body with them ... share with them (R)
alternatives: fellow heirs and fellow members of the body and fellow sharers
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the three "together" words in natural English. Readable names who the Gentiles share with (m9) and explains "heirs" as receiving what God has promised to give.

decisions.choice: riches no one can ever fully trace (B); riches too great for anyone to measure (R)
decisions.reason: Says what "untraceable" means here (m13). Literal keeps the picture of a trail.

decisions.choice: to make plain to everyone how the mystery is being carried out (B); helping everyone see how he is carrying out his mystery (R)
decisions.reason: "Plan" in Literal and "carried out" at the other levels both give the sense of m14; "administration" would suggest an office.

decisions.choice: the rulers and authorities in the heavenly world, the unseen powers
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "rulers and authorities" and adds who they are (m19). "In the heavenly world" is Readable's way of saying "in the heavenly places" throughout Ephesians.

decisions.choice: we can come to God boldly and with confidence (B); we can come near to God boldly and without fear (R)
alternatives: we have boldness and access with confidence
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say to whom believers have access (m22; 2:18).

decisions.choice: servidor
decisions.reason: "Servidor" says plainly that Paul serves the gospel (m11). "Diácono" would point to the church office, "ministro" to a clergy title or a government minister, and "siervo" is kept apart from "esclavo" for the slave (doulos) words of Paul's letters.

decisions.choice: imposibles de rastrear (L); que nadie podrá jamás rastrear del todo (B)
decisions.reason: Keeps the picture of a trail whose tracks cannot be followed to the end (m13). "Inescrutables" and "insondables" are learned words that lose the picture.

decisions.choice: siri (key term for the whole book)
decisions.reason: Swahili has one word, "siri", for both a secret and a mystery. That fits Paul's sense well: a secret of God's purpose that he has now made known (m2), not a puzzle ("fumbo"). Because "siri" can sound like something still kept back, Readable adds "yaani mpango aliokuwa ameuficha" (that is, the plan he had kept hidden), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: wanadamu, no gender span
decisions.reason: "Wanadamu" is itself "children of Adam", the ordinary Swahili word for human beings, men and women alike, so it renders the Hebrew-style phrase (m6) word for word and needs no traditional alternative.

decisions.choice: [mahali] pa mbinguni (L); ulimwengu wa mbinguni (B, R)
decisions.reason: The unseen realm where Christ reigns and the powers still act (m19) is said with "mbinguni" (in heaven), kept as "ulimwengu wa mbinguni" (the heavenly world) at Balanced and Readable for the rest of the letter. "Ulimwengu wa roho" (the spirit world) is also possible, but it can suggest the world of ancestral spirits.

source.text: διὸ αἰτοῦμαι μὴ ἐγκακεῖν ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσίν μου ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, ἥτις ἐστὶν δόξα ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore I ask not to lose heart in the afflictions of me on behalf of you, which is glory of you.

en.L: So I ask [you] not to lose heart at my afflictions for you, which is your glory.
en.B: So I ask you not to lose heart over the troubles I bear for your sake. They are your glory.
en.R: So I ask you not to lose heart because I am suffering for you. My troubles are for your good. They are your glory.

es.L: Por eso pido que no {{plural_you:se desanimen|os desaniméis}} ante mis aflicciones por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, lo cual es {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} gloria.
es.B: Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego que no {{plural_you:pierdan|perdáis}} el ánimo por las aflicciones que llevo por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Ellas son {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} gloria.
es.R: Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} pido que no {{plural_you:se desanimen|os desaniméis}} porque estoy sufriendo por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Mis sufrimientos son para {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} bien. Son motivo de gloria para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo naomba msife moyo katika dhiki zangu kwa ajili yenu, jambo ambalo ni utukufu wenu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nawaomba msife moyo kwa sababu ya dhiki ninazopata kwa ajili yenu. Hizo ni utukufu wenu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nawaomba msivunjike moyo kwa sababu ninateseka kwa ajili yenu. Mateso yangu ni kwa faida yenu. Mateso hayo ni utukufu wenu.

decisions.choice: I ask you not to lose heart
alternatives: I pray that I may not lose heart
decisions.reason: αἰτοῦμαι ("I ask") does not say who is not to lose heart. Because Paul goes on "my afflictions for you, which is your glory", the readers are the ones in danger of being discouraged by his imprisonment. The words could also mean that Paul asks God that he himself may not give up (compare 2 Corinthians 4:1, 16).

decisions.choice: afflictions: the hardships Paul bears as a prisoner
decisions.reason: θλίψεσίν means pressure and hardship. Paul suffers "for you", because he brought the gospel to the Gentiles (verse 1).

decisions.choice: which is your glory: Paul's sufferings for them are to their honor and serve their share in God's glory
decisions.reason: ἥτις is singular and takes its form from "glory"; it refers to the sufferings as a whole. The Gentiles need not be ashamed that their apostle is in chains: he suffers because he brought them the gospel, and that is to their honor and leads to their glory (compare 2 Corinthians 4:17; Colossians 1:24).

decisions.choice: [you] (L); you (B, R)
decisions.reason: English needs the person Paul is asking; the reading is explained in m1.

decisions.choice: My troubles are for your good. They are your glory.
decisions.reason: Readable says how Paul's sufferings can be their glory (m3).

decisions.choice: no bracketed pronoun in Literal
decisions.reason: The plural verb "se desanimen" / "os desaniméis" already names the readers as the ones who should not lose heart (m1), so Literal needs no bracketed "[les]" where the English needs "[you]". Balanced and Readable add "les" / "os" after "pido" as natural Spanish.

decisions.choice: naomba msife moyo, no bracket; jambo ambalo
decisions.reason: The prefix "m-" in "msife moyo" already marks the readers as the ones who should not lose heart (m1), so Literal needs no bracketed pronoun. "Jambo ambalo" (a thing which) keeps the singular "which is" of the Greek, which points to the sufferings as a whole (m3).

source.text: Τούτου χάριν κάμπτω τὰ γόνατά μου πρὸς τὸν πατέρα, ἐξ οὗ πᾶσα πατριὰ ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς ὀνομάζεται, ἵνα δῷ ὑμῖν κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ δυνάμει κραταιωθῆναι διὰ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν ἔσω ἄνθρωπον, κατοικῆσαι τὸν Χριστὸν διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν ἐν ἀγάπῃ· ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ τεθεμελιωμένοι, ἵνα ἐξισχύσητε καταλαβέσθαι σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις τί τὸ πλάτος καὶ μῆκος καὶ ὕψος καὶ βάθος, γνῶναί τε τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν τῆς γνώσεως ἀγάπην τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἵνα πληρωθῆτε εἰς πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ θεοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: For this reason I bend the knees of me toward the Father, \v 15 from whom every family in heavens and on earth is named, \v 16 that he may give to you according to the riches of the glory of him with power to be strengthened through the Spirit of him into the inner man, \v 17 to dwell the Christ through the faith in the hearts of you in love; having been rooted and having been founded, \v 18 so that you may be fully strong to grasp with all the holy [ones] what [is] the breadth and length and height and depth, \v 19 to know and the surpassing the knowledge love of the Christ, so that you may be filled unto all the fullness of the God.

en.L: For this reason I bow my knees before the Father, \v 15 from whom every family in [the] heavens and on earth is named, \v 16 that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may grant you, according to the riches of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, to be made strong with power through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit in the inner {{gender:person|man}}, \v 17 that the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} [may] dwell in your hearts through faith in love; being rooted and founded, \v 18 that you may be fully able to grasp with all the holy ones what [is] the breadth and length and height and depth, \v 19 and to know the love of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} that surpasses knowledge, so that you may be filled to all the fullness of God.
en.B: For this reason I kneel before the Father, \v 15 from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name. \v 16 I pray that, in keeping with the riches of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will give you power, making your inner {{gender:self|man}} strong through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit, \v 17 so that through faith and in love {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} will make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home in your hearts. You are rooted deep and set on a firm foundation, \v 18 and I pray that you will have the strength to grasp, with all God's holy people, the breadth and length and height and depth, \v 19 and to know the love of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, a love that goes beyond knowledge, so that you may be filled up to all the fullness of God.
en.R: This is why I kneel and pray to the Father. \v 15 Every family in heaven and on earth gets its name from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 16 I pray that God, out of the great riches of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, will make you strong deep inside with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power, through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit. \v 17 I pray that {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} will make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home in your hearts through faith, and live there in love. Your lives have roots that go down deep, and they stand on a firm foundation. \v 18 So I pray that you, together with all God's people, will be strong enough to understand how wide and long and high and deep the love of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is. \v 19 I pray that you will know this love, even though it is too great to be fully known. Then you will be filled completely with all that God is and gives.

es.L: Por esta razón doblo mis rodillas ante el Padre, \v 15 de quien toda familia en [los] cielos y sobre [la] tierra es nombrada, \v 16 para que {{plural_you:les|os}} conceda, conforme a las riquezas de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, ser fortalecidos con poder por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu en el {{gender:ser|hombre}} interior, \v 17 que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} habite en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones por medio de la fe en amor; enraizados y cimentados, \v 18 para que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} plena fuerza para captar junto con todos los santos qué [es] lo ancho y lo largo y lo alto y lo profundo, \v 19 y conocer el amor {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} que va más allá del conocimiento, para que {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} llenados hasta toda la plenitud de Dios.
es.B: Por esta razón me arrodillo ante el Padre, \v 15 de quien recibe su nombre toda familia en el cielo y en la tierra. \v 16 Pido que, conforme a las riquezas de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dé poder y fortalezca {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} {{gender:ser|hombre}} interior por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu, \v 17 para que, por la fe y en el amor, {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} haga {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} morada en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones. {{plural_you:Están|Estáis}} bien arraigados y asentados sobre un cimiento firme, \v 18 y pido que {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} la fuerza para comprender, junto con todo el pueblo santo de Dios, la anchura y la longitud y la altura y la profundidad, \v 19 y para conocer el amor {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, un amor que va más allá de todo conocimiento, para que {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} llenos hasta toda la plenitud de Dios.
es.R: Por eso me arrodillo y oro al Padre. \v 15 Toda familia en el cielo y en la tierra recibe de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} su nombre. \v 16 Pido que Dios, de las grandes riquezas de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, {{plural_you:los|os}} haga fuertes en lo más hondo de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} ser con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu. \v 17 Pido que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} haga {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hogar en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones por medio de la fe, y que viva allí en amor. {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestras}} vidas tienen raíces que bajan hondo, y están firmes sobre un buen cimiento. \v 18 Por eso pido que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, junto con todo el pueblo de Dios, {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} fuerza para entender lo ancho, lo largo, lo alto y lo profundo que es el amor {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. \v 19 Pido que {{plural_you:conozcan|conozcáis}} este amor, aunque es demasiado grande para conocerlo del todo. Entonces {{plural_you:quedarán|quedaréis}} llenos por completo de todo lo que Dios es y da.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hii ninapiga magoti yangu mbele ya Baba, \v 15 ambaye kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} kila ukoo mbinguni na duniani unaitwa jina, \v 16 ili awajalie, kulingana na utajiri wa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kutiwa nguvu kwa uweza kupitia Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} katika mtu wa ndani, \v 17 [ili] {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} akae ndani ya mioyo yenu kupitia imani, katika upendo; mkiwa mmetia mizizi na kuwekwa juu ya msingi, \v 18 ili mpate nguvu kamili ya kufahamu pamoja na watakatifu wote upana na urefu na kimo na kina [ni] nini, \v 19 na kuujua upendo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ulio juu kuliko ujuzi, ili mjazwe mpaka ukamilifu wote wa Mungu.
sw.B: Kwa sababu hii ninapiga magoti mbele ya Baba, \v 15 ambaye kila ukoo mbinguni na duniani unapata jina lake kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. \v 16 Ninaomba kwamba, kulingana na utajiri wa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, awape nguvu, akiziimarisha nafsi zenu za ndani kupitia Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \v 17 ili kupitia imani na katika upendo, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} afanye makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ndani ya mioyo yenu. Ninyi mmetia mizizi kwa kina na mmejengwa juu ya msingi imara, \v 18 nami ninaomba mpate nguvu ya kufahamu, pamoja na watakatifu wote, upana na urefu na kimo na kina, \v 19 na kuujua upendo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, upendo unaopita ujuzi wote, ili mjazwe hadi kufikia ukamilifu wote wa Mungu.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu ninapiga magoti na kumwomba Baba. \v 15 Kila ukoo mbinguni na duniani unapata jina lake kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}. \v 16 Ninaomba kwamba Mungu, kutokana na wingi wa utajiri wa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, awafanye imara ndani kabisa mwenu kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, kupitia Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \v 17 Ninaomba kwamba {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} afanye makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mioyoni mwenu kupitia imani, na akae humo kwa upendo. Maisha yenu yana mizizi inayoingia chini sana, na yamesimama juu ya msingi imara. \v 18 Kwa hiyo ninaomba kwamba ninyi, pamoja na watu wote wa Mungu, mpate nguvu ya kuelewa jinsi upendo wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ulivyo mpana, mrefu, wa juu na wa kina. \v 19 Ninaomba mjue upendo huu, ingawa ni mkubwa mno kiasi kwamba hauwezi kujulikana kikamilifu. Ndipo mtajazwa kabisa na Mungu mwenyewe na yote anayowapa.

decisions.choice: for this reason: Paul takes up again the sentence he broke off in verse 1
decisions.reason: Τούτου χάριν repeats the opening words of verse 1. The reason is what chapters 2 and 3 have said: Gentiles brought near and made one body with Israel, by a plan God has now revealed. Now Paul says what he does about it: he prays.

decisions.choice: I bow my knees: I kneel to pray, a sign of deep reverence and earnest asking
decisions.reason: Jews commonly stood to pray (Mark 11:25; Luke 18:11). Kneeling showed deep reverence or urgent need (Luke 22:41; Acts 7:60). Paul knelt to pray with the elders of the church at Ephesus when he took leave of them (Acts 20:36).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "the Father"
alternatives: "the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "of our Lord Jesus Christ", the reading of the King James Version. The earliest manuscripts lack the words, and without them the link between "Father" and "family" in verse 15 stands out.

decisions.choice: every family: every group descended from a common father, in heaven and on earth, takes its name, and so its being, from God the Father
alternatives: the whole family (of believers) in heaven and on earth
decisions.reason: πατριὰ comes from πατήρ ("father") and means a family or clan traced to a forefather (Luke 2:4). Acts 3:25 uses it for "all the families of the earth" blessed through Abraham. The play on words says that God is the Father behind every family. Without the article, πᾶσα πατριὰ means "every family", not "the whole family" as in the King James Version: the peoples of the earth, and the ranks of beings in heaven. To name something was to give it its place and being (Genesis 2:19-20; Psalm 147:4).

decisions.choice: according to the riches of his glory: in a measure that matches God's glorious wealth
decisions.reason: κατὰ ("according to") says that God gives in proportion to his riches, not merely out of them (1:7; Philippians 4:19). His glory is the shining greatness of who he is.

decisions.choice: the inner person: the self within, the mind and heart that God renews
decisions.reason: τὸν ἔσω ἄνθρωπον is the inner self, as distinct from the body (Romans 7:22; 2 Corinthians 4:16, where the outer person wastes away while the inner is renewed day by day). ἄνθρωπον means a human being, not a male.

decisions.choice: that Christ may dwell in your hearts: the result of being made strong, and another way of saying the same thing
decisions.reason: The infinitive κατοικῆσαι follows "to be made strong" without a joining word. It can be a second request or the result of the first; either way, the Spirit's strengthening and Christ's living within are one work. The verb means to settle and make one's home, not to visit (Colossians 1:19; 2:9). The readers are already believers; Paul prays that Christ will be fully at home in them.

decisions.choice: "in love" ends the clause about Christ living in their hearts, as the SBLGNT punctuates it; "rooted and founded" begins the next thought
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT puts a raised dot after ἀγάπῃ, so love is the setting in which Christ lives in their hearts. Many editions join "in love" to the words that follow: "rooted and founded in love". Either way love is where their life is planted. The participles ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ τεθεμελιωμένοι are plural and in the nominative case, though "you" in verses 16-17 is not; they describe the readers loosely and lead into the request of verse 18.

decisions.choice: rooted and founded: pictures of a plant and of a building
decisions.reason: Believers are like a tree with deep roots and a building on a firm foundation (Colossians 2:7; Ephesians 2:20-22). Both verbs are perfect: God has already planted and founded them, and they stand.

decisions.choice: be fully able to grasp with all the holy ones: understanding that comes in the company of all believers
decisions.reason: ἐξισχύσητε is a strong word: "have full strength". καταλαβέσθαι means to seize, and so to grasp with the mind. "With all the holy ones" means this is not knowledge for a few: it is grasped together, by the whole people of God.

decisions.choice: the breadth and length and height and depth: most likely of Christ's love
alternatives: the whole plan of God, the mystery of verses 3-11
the new temple God is building (2:21-22)
decisions.reason: Paul does not say what is being measured. Verse 19 goes straight on to "to know the love of Christ", so his love is the most likely object. The four measurements may also recall the measuring of a building or temple (2:21-22) or older writing on God's wisdom, higher than heaven and deeper than the grave (Job 11:7-9). Whatever is measured, the point is that it cannot be measured.

decisions.choice: to know the love of Christ that surpasses knowledge: Christ's love for his people, which can be truly known though never fully
decisions.reason: τοῦ Χριστοῦ is Christ's love for them (5:2, 5:25). The words play on "know" and "knowledge": believers are to know what goes beyond knowing. They know it truly, by experience, though they will never come to its end.

decisions.choice: filled to all the fullness of God: filled with all that God gives of himself, up to the full measure he intends
alternatives: filled with God's own being, as if believers became divine
decisions.reason: εἰς points to a goal: "up to", "into". In Christ all the fullness of God lives in bodily form (Colossians 2:9), and the church is called Christ's fullness (1:23). Paul prays that they will be filled more and more toward all that God is and gives, the goal described in 4:13 as "the fullness of Christ". They do not stop being creatures; God fills them with his presence and life.

decisions.choice: I kneel and pray to the Father
alternatives: I bow my knees before the Father
decisions.reason: Readable says what kneeling is for here (m2).

decisions.choice: takes its name (B); gets its name (R)
decisions.reason: "Is named" from the Father is said more naturally as taking one's name from him (m4).

decisions.choice: inner {{gender:person|man}} (L); inner {{gender:self|man}} (B)
decisions.reason: The phrase means the inner self of every believer (m6), so the default is inclusive; "inner man" is the traditional form. Readable says "deep inside".

decisions.choice: make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home
decisions.reason: Brings out that the verb means settling in to live, not a passing visit (m7).

decisions.choice: You are rooted deep and set on a firm foundation (B); Your lives have roots that go down deep, and they stand on a firm foundation (R)
decisions.reason: The two participles become a sentence of their own, since English cannot attach them loosely as the Greek does (m8, m9).

decisions.choice: how wide and long and high and deep the love of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is
alternatives: the breadth and length and height and depth
decisions.reason: Readable names the love of Christ as what is measured, taking the most likely sense (m11), which Literal and Balanced leave unstated.

decisions.choice: filled completely with all that God is and gives
alternatives: filled to all the fullness of God
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the fullness of God" (m13).

decisions.choice: ukoo
decisions.reason: Greek plays on "Father" and "family" (m4). Swahili cannot keep the play with an ordinary word: "ubaba" (fatherhood) keeps the sound link but does not mean a family or clan. "Ukoo" is the family or clan traced to a common forefather, which is the sense of the Greek word.

decisions.choice: mtu wa ndani (L); nafsi zenu za ndani (B); no gender span
decisions.reason: "Mtu" is a human being, man or woman, so the inner person (m6) needs no gender span in Swahili. Balanced says "nafsi zenu za ndani" (your inner selves), plural because Paul prays for all the readers. Readable says "ndani kabisa mwenu" (deep inside you).

decisions.choice: mtajazwa kabisa na Mungu mwenyewe na yote anayowapa
alternatives: mtajazwa na yote ambayo Mungu ni
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "all that God is and gives" (m13). Swahili has no natural way to say "all that God is", so Readable says "God himself and all that he gives you".

source.text: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑπὲρ πάντα ποιῆσαι ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ὧν αἰτούμεθα ἢ νοοῦμεν κατὰ τὴν δύναμιν τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἡμῖν, αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.

records.literal_gloss: Now to the [one] being able beyond all things to do far beyond abundantly [than the things] which we ask or think, according to the power that [is] working in us, \v 21 to him the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all the generations of the age of the ages; amen.

en.L: Now to the one who is able to do beyond all things, far more abundantly than what we ask or think, according to the power that is at work in us, \v 21 to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [be] the glory in the church and in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus to all the generations of the age of the ages. Amen.
en.B: Now to the one who is able to do all things, far beyond anything we ask or think, by the power that is at work in us, \v 21 to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} be glory in the church and in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, to every generation, for ever and ever. Amen.
en.R: God is able to do far more than anything we ask for, more than we can even imagine. He does this by {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power, which is at work in us. \v 21 May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} receive glory in the church and in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus, in every generation, for ever and ever! Amen.

es.L: Y al que puede hacer por encima de todas las cosas, sobreabundantemente más allá de lo que pedimos o pensamos, conforme al poder que obra en nosotros, \v 21 a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [sea] la gloria en la iglesia y en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús por todas las generaciones del siglo de los siglos. Amén.
es.B: Y a aquel que tiene poder para hacer todas las cosas, muy por encima de lo que pedimos o pensamos, por el poder que actúa en nosotros, \v 21 ¡a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la gloria en la iglesia y en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús, de generación en generación, por siempre jamás! Amén.
es.R: Dios puede hacer mucho más que todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pedimos, más aún de lo que podemos imaginar. Lo hace por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, que actúa en nosotros. \v 21 ¡Que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} reciba gloria en la iglesia y en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús, en cada generación, por siempre jamás! Amén.

sw.L: Sasa kwa yule anayeweza kufanya zaidi ya vitu vyote, kwa wingi upitao kiasi kuliko [yale] tunayoomba au tunayofikiri, kulingana na uweza unaofanya kazi ndani yetu, \v 21 {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} [uwe] utukufu katika kanisa na katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kwa vizazi vyote vya enzi ya enzi. Amina.
sw.B: Basi, kwa yule aliye na uwezo wa kufanya mambo yote, mbali zaidi ya chochote tunachoomba au kufikiri, kwa nguvu zile zinazofanya kazi ndani yetu, \v 21 utukufu uwe {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} katika kanisa na katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, kizazi hadi kizazi, milele na milele. Amina.
sw.R: Mungu anaweza kufanya mengi zaidi kuliko chochote tunachomwomba, zaidi hata ya yale tunayoweza kuwaza. Anafanya hivyo kwa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zinazofanya kazi ndani yetu. \v 21 Na apewe utukufu katika kanisa na katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu, katika kila kizazi, milele na milele! Amina.

decisions.choice: to the one who is able: God, the Father to whom Paul has prayed (verse 14)
decisions.reason: The praise names God by what he can do. ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ piles up prefixes: "beyond, out of, more than enough"; Paul uses it also in 1 Thessalonians 3:10 and 5:13. God's power goes past not only what believers ask but anything they can think of.

decisions.choice: the power at work in us: the same power that raised Christ from the dead
decisions.reason: δύναμιν and ἐνεργουμένην echo 1:19-20, where the power at work for believers is the power God worked in raising Christ. It is already at work in them.

decisions.choice: glory in the church and in Christ Jesus: God is praised in the church and in Christ, its head
decisions.reason: "To him [be] the glory" is both a wish and an act of praise; the verb is left unstated, as usual in such praises (Romans 11:36; Galatians 1:5). Setting the church beside Christ Jesus fits this letter, where the church is his body and his fullness (1:22-23) and where God's wisdom is displayed through it (3:10).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "in the church and in Christ Jesus"
decisions.reason: Some manuscripts lack καὶ ("and"), giving "in the church in Christ Jesus"; a few put Christ Jesus first. The SBLGNT follows the early manuscripts that read "in the church and in Christ Jesus".

decisions.choice: to all the generations of the age of the ages: for all time, without end
decisions.reason: Two ways of speaking of endless time are joined: "to all generations" (Psalm 145:13) and "the age of the ages", a Hebrew way of stressing something, like "holy of holies".

decisions.choice: amen: so be it
decisions.reason: ἀμήν is a Hebrew word meaning "surely, so be it". The congregation said it to agree with a blessing or praise (Deuteronomy 27:15-26; 1 Corinthians 14:16), as the readers would when the letter was read.

decisions.choice: God is able
alternatives: Now to the one who is able
decisions.reason: Readable names God for "the one who is able" (m1) and breaks the praise into short sentences.

decisions.choice: to every generation, for ever and ever (B); in every generation, for ever and ever (R)
alternatives: to all the generations of the age of the ages
decisions.reason: The usual English way of saying "to all the generations of the age of the ages" (m5); Literal keeps the Greek form.

decisions.choice: May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} receive glory
decisions.reason: Readable makes the unstated verb a plain wish (m3).

decisions.choice: de generación en generación, por siempre jamás (B); en cada generación, por siempre jamás (R)
alternatives: por los siglos de los siglos
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "del siglo de los siglos", the Greek form (m5). Balanced and Readable say "for all time" in everyday Spanish; "por los siglos de los siglos" is familiar from liturgy but reads as a set formula.

decisions.choice: kwake [uwe] utukufu (L); utukufu uwe kwake (B); Na apewe utukufu (R)
decisions.reason: Keeps "utukufu" (glory), the key term, as a noun at every level, as the Greek does, rather than the verb "atukuzwe" (may he be glorified). Readable makes the unstated verb a wish, "na apewe" (may he be given), as the English Readable does (m3).
